meta.name: paid-ads-setup
meta.description: Connect NotFair paid-ad accounts and establish reusable campaign context. Use when setting up paid media in a new workspace, connecting Google, Meta, X, or LinkedIn Ads, refreshing brand context, or preparing an agent to work on ads safely.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接主流广告平台账户,让投放助手即刻就位
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用广告投放但不知道从哪开始
copy.tagline_en: Connect ad accounts and prepare your workspace for paid media
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to paid ads and need help getting started

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会连接NotFair广告账户，识别要接入的平台（Google、Meta、X等），只显示真实存在的账户让你选，并读取营销文档，只问文档没写的信息（产品、预算、转化等）。它不会改动现有广告，最后给出一份“还缺什么、下一步做什么”的清单。
howto.when: 当你在新工作区配置付费媒体、连接Google、Meta等广告账户，或需要刷新品牌上下文、准备让智能体安全地处理广告时触发。

say.text: 接入我的Google Ads账户，并列出可用账户
say.note: 只显示真实返回的账户，供你选择

say.text: 在新工作区设置付费广告环境，先读取项目文档
say.note: 会读取营销文档，再问缺什么

say.text: 这是预算和产品信息，请告诉我还缺什么
say.note: 会生成差距清单，标明下一步

howto.what_en: Connects NotFair ad accounts, lists real accounts for user to pick, reads marketing docs, asks only missing info, and ends with a gap register (missing items, next action). Doesn't alter campaigns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up paid media in a new workspace, connect Google, Meta, or other ad accounts, refresh brand context, or prepare an agent to work on ads safely.

say_en.text: Connect my Google Ads account to NotFair and list available accounts
say_en.note: Only shows accounts actually returned, for you to pick.

say_en.text: Set up paid media in my new workspace, starting with project docs
say_en.note: Reads marketing docs, then asks only missing gaps.

say_en.text: Here are budget and product info. Tell me what's missing
say_en.note: Generates a gap register with next steps.
